stepResult.label: Step result ID

moment.label: Moment (seconds)

longestSide.label: Longest side (pixels)

description.soundEffect: The sound, for example "heavy wooden door creaking open, then a soft thud"

what.planNote: A composition plan is set under Advanced; its sections set the length, so there is no description or duration here.

length.label: Length (seconds)

loop.label: Make it a seamless loop

cost.nullMeansSoundEffect: Blank uses the default sound effect provider.

takes.label: Takes

save.label: Save to project files

sourceKind.StepOutput: A picture from an earlier step
sourceKind.StepResult: A picture from an earlier run

what.modeAria: Make new pictures or edit one

prompt.label: Description

instruction.label: What to change

itemList.label: Items (one per line)
itemList.description: One picture is made for each item, up to 24. Write one per line or separate them with commas. Use '{'item'}' in the description or the change to say where the item goes, for example "a '{'item'}' sofa in a bright living room". Leave empty to make a single picture.

stepResult.label: Step result id
stepResult.description: The id of a finished step result from an earlier run of this project

egress.label: Allow sending this picture to the AI service
egress.description: Required for editing. The picture is shared with the hosted model for 10 minutes. Until you tick this, a run stops with EGRESS_REFUSED and nothing is sent.

cost.nullMeansGenerate: Blank uses the default image generation provider.
cost.nullMeansEdit: Blank uses the default image edit provider.

variations.label: Pictures
variations.description: Separate pictures to choose from, 1 to {max}. Each one is paid for.

limit.label: Spending limit (credits)
limit.description: Stops the step before it spends more than this. Empty limits it to the priced total.

cost.noLimitWarning: No spending limit is set. Set one so a picture count you mistyped cannot spend more than you expect.

save.label: Save to project files
save.description: Lists each picture in Files so you can see, download and reuse it

advanced.description: Picture shape and the saved file name. The defaults suit almost every step.

aspect.label: Aspect ratio
aspect.description: For example 16:9 or 1:1, where the model takes one. Not with a width and height.

width.label: Width (pixels)
width.description: Use with height. Not with an aspect ratio.

height.label: Height (pixels)
height.description: Use with width. Not with an aspect ratio.

size.helper: The picture is made at the closest size the model can draw, then resized to exactly this size. For example 2000 x 2000.
size.tierTooSmall: Too small: {tier} makes pictures up to {edge} pixels on the long edge, but the exact size needs {need}. Pick a larger resolution or Automatic.
size.clearExactFirst: Clear the exact size to use this.

prefix.label: File name prefix
prefix.description: Letters, digits, - and _ (1 to 40). Empty uses image.

conditional.intro: Pick which step runs next when the condition is true or false.

hints.conditionExpression: A formula over earlier outputs, e.g. steps[1].score >= 7. In Decision mode it also seeds the question the model is asked.
hints.decisionQuestion: Optional short name for the yes/no question. Leave blank to derive one from the expression.
hints.thresholdDecision: The branch is True when the model’s probability of "yes" is at least this. 0.5 = a coin flip.
hints.thresholdExpression: Only used in Decision mode (ignored while Expression is selected).
hints.timeoutSeconds: How long to wait for the Decision provider. On timeout the step evaluates False, it never fails.

mode.decision: Decision: ask a decision model a yes/no question
mode.decisionHint: The step asks a Decision provider a yes/no question first. With no Decision provider configured it falls back to the False branch. Calls a model, so it can cost tokens.
mode.expressionHint: Deterministic: the condition expression is evaluated locally, no model call.

provider.description: Which Decision-capable provider answers. Blank uses the default one.
provider.nullMeans: Without one, a Decision-mode step evaluates False.
provider.onlyDecision: Decision provider: only used in Decision mode.

branch.trueDescription: Step that runs when the condition holds

earlierFields.label: Fields earlier steps produce
earlierFields.description: Field names you can use in the expression above.

designSystem.intro: Reads your design files and app structure into a brand and product profile. Free — no AI model is involved.

parse.includeProductMap: Read the product structure (pages, parts, libraries)
parse.chooseOne: Choose at least one thing to read.

limits.label: Limits
limits.description: How many files to read and how large they may be.

extraGlobs.label: Also read files matching
extraGlobs.description: Type a pattern, e.g. docs/**/*.md. Up to 20 patterns, 100 characters each.

parseStep.label: Which earlier step read your files
parseStep.description: Its result is combined into the profile this step saves.
parseStep.missing: Choose which earlier step read your files: this step combines nothing without it.

designFallback.label: Brand fallback steps (optional)
designFallback.description: Steps whose result can fill a missing brand profile.

productFallback.label: Product profile fallback steps (optional)

compose.ingest: Save the profile for this project

require.chooseOne: Choose at least one: a profile the step requires, or it always fails.

reviewLoop.intro: A reviewer scores the target step's output; below the minimum score the target runs again, up to the iteration cap.

labels.loopTargetStepOrder: Step to re-run when the score is too low
labels.enabled: Early stop with a decision model

hints.minScore: Leave blank to let the review agent decide when the work is good enough.
hints.maxIterations: A hard cap so a loop can never run forever. Each round costs a review plus a re-run.
hints.enabled: Off (default): the reviewer always runs. On: a Decision provider may accept the work early and skip a review, saving tokens. Anything uncertain still goes to the reviewer.
hints.acceptAt: How sure the decision model must be that the score passes (0-1). Higher = fewer early stops. 0.85 is an untuned default.
hints.bimodalMargin: If the top two score levels are closer than this, the reviewer runs instead. 0.15 is an untuned default.
hints.timeoutSeconds: Gate-level budget; on timeout the reviewer runs as normal.
hints.loopTargetStepOrder: The step whose output is reviewed and re-run, usually the author or editor step above this one.

provider.description: Only used when early stop is on. Blank uses the default Decision provider.
provider.nullMeans: With no Decision provider the reviewer simply always runs.

advanced.label: Advanced: visual check
advanced.description: Optionally look at the video's frames for cut-off or unreadable text before each review.

reviewLoop.scoreHint: The review agent expects the target step to produce a 'score' field (1-10) in its output.

enabled.label: Check the picture before each review
enabled.description: Looks at a few frames of the video for text that is cut off, too close to the edge or too small to read, and tells the reviewer.

frames.label: Frames to look at
frames.description: 2 to 16. More frames find more problems and cost more.

visualCheck.failScoreCap: Highest score when a serious problem is found (0-10)

safeMargin.label: Safe margin (% of the frame)
safeMargin.description: Text closer to the edge than this is flagged. 0 to 20.

minText.label: Smallest readable text (% of the frame height)

vision.label: Vision model
vision.description: The model that looks at the frames. Blank uses the default Vision model.

operation.label: Operation
operation.description: What this step does to the earlier results. No AI is involved.
operation.Project: Keep the key details: trim a list down to the fields you choose
operation.Resolve: Look up chosen items: fetch the full entries for a list of picks
operation.Files: Read project files: list or summarise them

path.label: Path
path.description: JSON path resolved against the source, e.g. $.components

idsPath.label: IDs path
idsPath.description: JSON path inside the ids input, e.g. $.selectedIds

recordsPath.label: Records path
recordsPath.description: JSON path inside the records input, e.g. $.view.items

output.expectations: Expectations (fail fast before the next step runs)

requiredPaths.label: Required paths
requiredPaths.description: JSON paths that must be present in the output view

nonEmpty.label: Non-empty string paths
nonEmpty.description: Paths that must resolve to a non-empty string

technical.label: Technical details
technical.description: The exact format this step hands to the next one.
technical.handsOver: What this step hands to the next one

placeholder.denied: Default {noun} model (not available to your role)

provider.deniedNote: Your role cannot choose a model, so {noun} runs on the workspace default.

schemaForm.unapplied: Unapplied changes: click Apply to keep them

preset.Master: Master — the timeline's own size, highest quality

timelineRender.intro: Turns one of this project's editor timelines into a finished video file. The cut, the layers and the audio levels come from the timeline itself; this step only chooses the delivery format. No AI model is involved.

timeline.label: Timeline
timeline.description: An editor timeline of this project
timeline.none: No timelines in this project yet
timeline.idDescription: The id of the editor timeline to render
timeline.required: Choose a timeline: the step cannot run without one.

revision.label: Revision
revision.description: Leave blank to render the latest revision when the step starts; the run records the revision it used.

fileName.label: File name
fileName.description: Letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes and underscores; no folders

delivery.register: Also list the file in this project's Files

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.description: Part of the timeline, custom encoding and loudness normalisation.

encoding.rateControl: How to set the file size

rateMode.Capped: Look first, with a size limit

normalise.label: Normalise the programme loudness
normalise.description: Two-pass measurement to a broadcast-style target. Off: the mix is measured but left as the timeline set it.

selection.Auto: Pick the best moment for me (recommended)
selection.AtTime: Take one exact moment I choose

fit.Cover: Fill the image and crop the edges

thumbnailGenerate.intro: Takes one frame out of your footage and saves it as an image — the picture people see before they press play. No AI model is involved, and nothing about the video itself changes.

frame.autoHint: The moment is chosen from what the Watch footage step measured: the strongest take, how sharp and how calm the frame is, and whether the same moment was filmed more than once. Add a Watch footage step above this one to get started.
frame.atTimeHint: You give the exact moment. Nothing is chosen for you, so this also works on a clip the Watch footage step never looked at.

footage.label: Footage
footage.description: The 'Watch footage' step whose clips the frame is taken from

footageNumber.label: Footage step number
footageNumber.description: The number of the 'Watch footage' step whose clips the frame is taken from

frame.noFootage: No 'Watch footage' step comes before this one, so there is nothing to take a frame from yet. Add one and move it above this step.

moment.label: Moment (seconds)
moment.description: Where in the clip to take the frame, counting from its start

clip.label: Clip number
clip.description: Which analysed clip to read, counting from 1. 1 is the first.

candidates.label: Moments to score
candidates.description: More moments can find a better frame and take a little longer (1 to 500)

minShot.label: Ignore moments shorter than (seconds)
minShot.description: A very short shot is usually a flash frame

bestTake.label: Prefer the best attempt
bestTake.description: When the same moment was filmed more than once, use the best take rather than the highest score alone.

width.label: Width (pixels)
width.description: 16 to 4096. 1280 fits every platform's cover image.

height.label: Height (pixels)
height.description: 16 to 4096. 720 with the width above is the usual 16:9 cover.

quality.label: Image quality
quality.description: 2 is the best quality and 31 the smallest file. 4 is a good default.

fileName.label: File name
fileName.description: A name only, not a folder

save.label: Save to project files
save.description: Lists the image in Files so you can download it or set it as the video's cover

text.label: Text on the image
text.description: Usually the video's headline. Leave blank for no text.

overlay.nothingDrawn: Nothing will be drawn yet: type the text above.
overlay.burnedIn: The text is written into the picture, so it cannot be edited or translated afterwards. Keep it short — long text shrinks to fit.

boxColor.label: Panel behind the text
boxColor.description: Keeps the text readable over a busy picture

advanced.description: Reusing an earlier run's footage analysis. The defaults suit almost every thumbnail.

reuse.label: Reuse footage analysis from an earlier run (result ID)
reuse.placeholder: Leave blank to use this run's analysis

voiceover.intro: Reads your narration aloud with an AI voice.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the words come from: type them yourself, use the script an earlier step wrote, or use the narration an earlier step wrote for the edit.

lines.title: Voiceover lines
lines.empty: No voiceover lines. Click "Add line" to get started.

script.label: Script step
script.description: The earlier step that wrote the script. Each scene's narration is read aloud.

narration.label: Narration writer step
narration.description: The earlier step that writes the narration. Each of its lines is read aloud.
narration.readOnly: The lines come from that step, so they cannot be edited here.

pickup.label: Re-recording planner step
pickup.description: The earlier step that chose which sentences to re-record. Pick the presenter's own voice below so the new lines match.

voice.label: Voice
voice.descriptionProject: A voice from this project. Only voices with permission to use them are offered.
voice.descriptionNoProject: Save the workflow inside a project to pick one of its voices.
voice.none: No voices in this project yet

language.label: Language (optional)
language.description: e.g. en-US, or es-ES for a Spanish version

voice.manage: Choose or add voices in this project's Voices tab

service.cost: The voice service charges per character read. Running the same lines again reuses the audio already made.
service.label: Speech service
service.description: Which voice service reads the lines. Blank uses the default one.
service.nullMeans: Without a speech service this step cannot make audio.

advanced.description: Voice model and ID, size limit, pronunciation and automatic voice casting.

model.label: Model (optional)
model.descriptionService: Blank uses the service's own model.

voiceId.label: Default voice ID
voiceId.description: A voice ID from the speech service, used when no project voice is chosen. Blank uses its default voice.

maxBytes.label: Audio size limit (bytes)
maxBytes.description: Safety cap on each line's audio (2,000,000 is about 1 minute of speech).

pronunciation.label: Pronunciation help
pronunciation.description: Auto teaches the voice how to say product and technology names found in your code (Fish Audio only).

casting.label: Automatic voice casting
casting.description: Lets a decision model pick one of the project's voices for these lines. Off uses the voice above.
casting.Decision: On: let the decision model choose

style.label: Caption style
style.Subtitle: Subtitle: a line or two at a time, on a box
style.Karaoke: Karaoke: each word lights up as it is spoken
style.Punch: Punch: one big bold word at a time
style.Bold: Bold: big words a few at a time, Reels/TikTok style

font.label: Font
font.licence: Every font here is built in and licensed for commercial use.

Auto.name: Automatic
Auto.hint: The best font for the style you picked

Inter.name: Inter
Inter.hint: Clean and very easy to read

Anton.name: Anton
Anton.hint: Heavy and punchy, the classic social look

position.label: Position
position.description: Captions always stay clear of the edges, and of the app buttons on vertical videos.
position.Auto: Automatic: bottom, or the middle for Punch

auto.label: Automatic text size
auto.description: Sized for the style and for phones. Turn off to set it yourself.

size.label: Text size (% of the video's height)

colour.noBox: {style} never uses a box: its words get a heavy outline.

maxChars.label: Longest caption (characters)
maxChars.description: A longer sentence is split at a word break.

errors.notList: Reframes must be a JSON list: [ '{' ... '}', '{' ... '}' ].
errors.notObject: Each reframe must be an object with a sourceIndex and its keyframes.

reframe.legend: Reframing, fits and inserts by reference

reframes.label: Reframes (JSON)
reframes.description: Zoom and pan over a stretch of a clip, eased between keyframes. Needs Re-encode mode. The server checks keyframe order, overlaps and ranges when you save and says what to fix.

fits.title: Fit for single clips
fits.description: Overrides "When a clip has a different shape" for one clip, for example a title card shown whole while the footage around it fills the frame. Ignored when the shape is "As filmed".

clip.label: Clip number
clip.description: Place in the Watch footage step (1 = first)

option.Crop: Fill the frame, crop the edges
option.Pad: Show the whole clip, fill the rest
option.Subject: Fill the frame around the subject

insertRef.label: Insert content by reference
insertRef.description: Names the content a screen shows when no entry above matches it (it takes the place of the single file above). A video or an image.

from.Step: The output of an earlier step
from.StepResult: The output of an earlier run (step result ID)

file.label: File
file.empty: No videos or images uploaded to this project

stepResult.label: Step result ID
stepResult.description: The ID of a step result from an earlier run of this project

reframe.needsReencode: Reframes need Re-encode mode; the server refuses them with Stream copy.

safeArea.label: Safe margin around text (fraction of the frame)
safeArea.description: Only when a clip is fitted around its subject: text is kept this far inside the edge. 0 to 0.25. Empty uses 0.05; 0 switches it off.

videoGenerate.intro: Generates new video clips from text. Every clip is a paid call.
videoGenerate.cost: Costs real money. The step refuses to start if its estimate exceeds Max spend, and your own daily video limit (Settings > Usage, none by default) applies on top. Max spend is a credit cap, like every other spend figure in ReelBolt. Identical re-runs reuse the cached clips unless you set Cache mode to Never.

what.label: What to generate
what.description: Type one prompt yourself, or make one clip for each new shot an earlier planning step proposed.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.unused: Unused while the prompt comes from a planner step
prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate (max 7000 chars)
prompt.placeholder: A serene landscape with mountains and clouds...

lookMatching.label: Match the surrounding footage's look
lookMatching.description: Appends the anchor shot's measured colour words (warm/cool, contrast, saturation) to each prompt. Needs the Analysis step above.

camera.label: Continue the anchor shot's camera move
camera.description: When the planner leaves the camera word blank, use the measured move of the real shot (static or handheld only). Needs the Analysis step above.

provider.label: Video generation provider
provider.description: Which provider renders the clips. Blank uses the default one.
provider.nullMeans: Without a Video generation provider this step fails before spending anything.

model.label: Model
model.comfyT2v: ComfyUI: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B text-to-video (self-hosted, GPU budget)
model.comfyI2v: ComfyUI: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B image-to-video (self-hosted, GPU budget)

maxClips.label: Max Clips
maxClips.description: Caps paid clips ({min}-{max}). Every take counts, so shots x takes must fit

maxSpend.label: Max spend (credits)
maxSpend.description: Hard cap on this step's spending, in credits — the unit every other spend figure in ReelBolt uses

maxGpu.label: Max GPU minutes (ComfyUI)
maxGpu.description: Hard cap on GPU time for a self-hosted ComfyUI provider, which bills nothing. Ignored by paid vendors; required instead of Max spend for ComfyUI.

loopBack.label: When this step runs again (loop-back)
loopBack.description: Reuse (default) serves clips with an identical prompt, model, duration and take that were already generated, at no cost. Regenerate pays for fresh clips on every loop-back. The Run/Retry dialog can also force regeneration.

egress.label: Allow sending your media to the video service
egress.description: Off stops the step before anything is sent: no frame of your footage, no start picture, no avatar's pictures, videos or voice samples. Only you can switch this on, here in the app.
egress.avatar: An avatar needs this switched on: its pictures and videos, and a person's voice samples, go to the video service.

frames.intro: Start the clip from a picture: the first frame, and optionally the last, taken from an earlier step that produced an image (for example a "Grab a frame" step). Only for a typed prompt, and only for models that accept it; the server says so before anything is spent.
frames.egressWarning: The picture is sent to the video service, so switch on "Allow sending your media to the video service" above, or the step stops before anything is spent.

fps.label: Conform to frame rate
fps.description: Frame-interpolate a lower-rate clip up to this fps (ffmpeg minterpolate). 0 keeps the clip's own rate; never downsamples.

height.label: Conform to height (px)
height.description: Upscale a smaller clip to this height, keeping its aspect. 0 keeps the clip's own size; never downscales.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.intro: Show a person from the project's Avatars tab in every take. Only an avatar whose consent is on record can be chosen.
avatar.introAny: Show a person or an object from the project's Avatars tab in every take. Only one that is ready can be chosen.
avatar.introObjects: Show an object from the project's Avatars tab in every take. Only one that is ready can be chosen.
avatar.label: Avatar to show
avatar.noneMeansRun: With None, the avatar chosen when the run starts (the Avatar field on the app page) is shown, if one is chosen there.

blocked.plan: An avatar works only with "Inline prompt": a step that makes clips from a planner step cannot show one.
blocked.frames: An avatar cannot be combined with a first or last frame. Remove the frames under Advanced to choose an avatar.

avatar.unusable: "{name}" cannot be used: {reason} The step would stop. Choose another avatar, or fix it in the Avatars tab.
avatar.missing: An avatar that no longer exists
avatar.missingHint: The chosen avatar was deleted. Choose another one, or None.
avatar.noAvatars: This project has no avatars yet.

roles.label: References to send
roles.description: Which of the avatar's files go to the video service. Untick a kind to leave it out.
roles.needPicture: Keep at least one picture (Face, Upper body or Full body).
roles.needPictureObject: Keep at least one picture (Front view, Another angle or Close-up detail).

speech.label: Speech the person says
speech.notForObjects: An object says nothing, so there is no speech to choose.

hint.yes: This model makes the person say this speech, word for word. The clip is as long as the speech, at most the duration above.
hint.no: This model does not make the person say a speech track: with one, the step is refused. For exact spoken lines, use a talking-head model, as the "Talking avatar (budget)" recipe does.
hint.unknown: Only talking-head models (as in the "Talking avatar (budget)" recipe) make the person say a speech track. Any other model refuses the step when it runs.

speech.noVoiceoverStep: No earlier step of this workflow is a Voiceover step.
speech.noAudioFiles: The project has no audio files. Upload one in the Files tab.

avatar.egressNeeded: Switch on "Allow sending your media to the video service" just below, or the step stops before anything is sent.

room.gateNote: The convening gate has no effect on the {badge} (it has no fixed set of answers a decision model could pick from). Leave it Off.

EditRoom.summary: Several AI editors discuss your footage and a lead editor settles on one cut, usually a better pick than a single editor working alone.
EditRoom.viewHelp: Which footage the team discusses: normally the step that watched your footage. The final-video step can use this team's choice exactly as it would a single editor's.

GraphicsRoom.summary: AI designers for layout, timing and wording discuss where titles and callouts go, and a lead designer settles on one plan. No titles at all is a valid outcome.
GraphicsRoom.viewHelp: Which footage the team discusses: pick the step that watched your footage, with "Find spots for titles" switched on. Choose it by name: "previous step" is usually the editor's choice instead.

ColorGradeRoom.summary: AI colourists discuss the look of your footage and a lead colourist settles on one colour look for the whole video. Keeping the original look is a valid outcome.
ColorGradeRoom.viewHelp: Which footage the team discusses: pick the step that watched your footage by name; "previous step" is usually the editor's choice instead.
ColorGradeRoom.labelPlaceholder: Step label (e.g. Color grade room deliberation)

DailiesRoom.summary: Continuity, motion and image judges + a director compare the generated takes of each planned shot, then pick ONE take per shot by its offered take id — never a score or a number.
DailiesRoom.viewHelp: Which step's bounded '{'view, meta'}' envelope the judges see — the VideoAnalyze step whose source is the GeneratedClips of the generation step (one analyzed source per delivered take, each with its take id). An empty selection is a valid outcome: every shot then keeps its first delivered take.
DailiesRoom.labelPlaceholder: Step label (e.g. Dailies room: pick one take per shot)

labels.fallbackToSoloEditor: If the team gets stuck, let one editor decide
labels.fallbackToSoloPlanner: If the team gets stuck, let one designer decide
labels.fallbackToSoloColorist: If the team gets stuck, let one colourist decide
labels.fallbackToSoloSelector: If the team gets stuck, let one judge decide

hints.rounds: How many times each team member speaks before the lead decides (1-6). More rounds take longer and cost more.
hints.maxTurns: Upper limit on how many times anyone speaks in total, so a discussion cannot run on.
hints.persistTranscript: Keeps the discussion so you can read it on the run page afterwards.
hints.conveneAcceptAt: Only read when the gate is not Off. 0.85 is an untuned default.
hints.conveneMinMargin: Only read when the gate is not Off. 0.25 is an untuned default.

scheduling.Questions: Questions: record convergence and next-speaker answers
scheduling.Adaptive: Adaptive: same as Questions for now
scheduling.questionsHint: After each director turn a decision model is asked "has the room converged?" and "who speaks next?". The answers are recorded for calibration only; the speaking order does not change. Uses the default Decision provider.
scheduling.fixedHint: The room speaks in a fixed order. No decision-model calls.

gate.Shadow: Shadow: observe only, never changes the outcome
gate.Gate: Gate: a decision model may skip the discussion
gate.gateHint: A Decision provider decides whether the room needs to meet at all; when it is confident the room is skipped, saving a whole discussion. Anything uncertain convenes as usual.
gate.shadowHint: The decision model runs alongside and its answer is recorded for the Calibration page, but the room always convenes.
gate.providerDescription: Only used when the gate is Shadow or Gate. Blank uses the default Decision provider.
gate.providerNullMeans: Without one the gate does nothing and the room convenes.

advanced.description: Decision-model options for teams that collect calibration data. Leave them off.

inputMapping.label: What this agent sees (input mapping)
inputMapping.description: Leave blank to give the agent everything earlier steps produced. Fill in to pick exactly which earlier results it sees.

cache.label: Reuse earlier results
cache.description: Normal reuses this step's result when nothing it depends on changed. Never always runs it again (use for a fresh creative take).

panel.agentAdvanced: What the agent sees from earlier steps, and when its result is reused.
panel.title: Step {n} settings: {role}
panel.rejected: The last save was rejected for this step
panel.proposes: The assistant proposes changes to {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} on this step
panel.proposesNote: Highlighted below. Nothing changes until you apply the proposal from the assistant.

inputMapping.label: Input Mapping JSON
inputMapping.description: Advanced. Leave blank to give the agent all earlier outputs. Fill in to pick exactly which earlier outputs it sees.

cache.label: Cache Mode
cache.description: Default reuses this step's result when nothing it depends on changed. Never always re-runs it (use for fresh creative takes).

sheet.proposes: The assistant proposes changes to {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} on this step
sheet.proposesNote: Highlighted below. Nothing changes until you apply the proposal from the assistant.

stepResultId.label: Step result ID
stepResultId.description: The ID of a step result from an earlier run of this project (shown on the run page)

chooseClips.label: Choose clips…
chooseClips.description: Pick every clip to use. They are cut together in the order listed below.

useSeveralClips.label: Use several clips
useSeveralClips.description: Cut several clips together into one video.

detectSilence.label: Detect silence
detectSilence.description: Finds pauses, so dead air can be cut out.

detectShots.label: Detect shots
detectShots.description: Finds where one shot ends and the next begins.

analyzeVisuals.label: Analyze visuals
analyzeVisuals.description: Measures movement, brightness and colour, and spots repeated takes.

analyzeAudioLevels.label: Analyze audio levels
analyzeAudioLevels.description: Measures how loud each shot is and how much of it is speech.

maxShotSec.label: Split shots longer than (seconds)
maxShotSec.description: Cuts long shots into shorter parts so the editor can keep only part of one. 0 = never split.

subShotMode.label: Cut points inside long shots
subShotMode.description: Where a long shot is cut into parts the editor can choose from.
subShotMode.Content: Where the picture pauses or changes

minSubShotSec.label: Shortest part (seconds)
minSubShotSec.description: No part is cut shorter than this.

maxSubShotSec.label: Longest part (seconds)
maxSubShotSec.description: Parts are kept at or under this length.

maxSubShotsPerShot.label: Most parts per shot
maxSubShotsPerShot.description: A very long shot gets longer parts rather than more of them.

speechToText.label: Speech-to-text service
speechToText.nullMeans: Without one, transcription is skipped (or the run stops, if set to Always).

language.label: Language
language.description: Two-letter code, e.g. en or fr. Leave blank to detect it.

imageAi.label: Image AI
imageAi.nullMeans: Without one, shots are not described.

maxCaptionedShots.label: At most this many shots
maxCaptionedShots.description: Caps the number of AI calls

locateSubjects.label: Find the subject of each shot
locateSubjects.description: Lets a vertical or square version keep what matters in the frame instead of cropping the middle. Uses the image AI above: two calls per shot.

maxSubjectShots.label: At most this many shots
maxSubjectShots.description: Caps the number of AI calls

emitOverlayPlacements.label: Find spots for titles
emitOverlayPlacements.description: Needed by a titles & graphics step or a graphics team.

offerMusicTracks.label: Offer your music tracks
offerMusicTracks.description: Needed by a music step. Uses the audio files you uploaded.

offerSfxClips.label: Offer your sound-effect clips
offerSfxClips.description: Needed by a sound-effects step. Uses the audio files you uploaded.

detectInsertRegions.label: Find green screens
detectInsertRegions.description: Finds a green (or blue) screen in the shot so the final video can show your content on it. Slower.

analyzeMusicBeats.label: Measure the music's beat
analyzeMusicBeats.description: Tells the editor the tempo, the bars, the drop and the ending of your music, so it can cut to the beat when you ask for it.

musicBeatTrackProjectFileId.label: Music the video is cut to
musicBeatTrackProjectFileId.description: Usually the same track as in the final step. Offered music tracks are measured too.
musicBeatTrackProjectFileId.empty: No audio files uploaded to this project

whatToFollow.label: What to follow / prompt
whatToFollow.description: Up to {max} characters. It is cleaned before it is sent, and never becomes part of a video command.

howToFollow.label: How to follow it
howToFollow.descriptionSegmentation: Sends the clip to the provider to follow this object frame by frame.
howToFollow.descriptionFeature: Runs on this server and costs nothing.

howManyTo.label: How many to follow
howManyTo.descriptionSingle: One object only: the first one the model finds, or the one you marked by hand.
howManyTo.descriptionAll: Every match, so hiding or blurring covers all of them and not just the first.

sendThisClip.label: Send this clip to the configured provider
sendThisClip.description: Required for segmentation. Until you tick this, a run stops with EGRESS_REFUSED and names the clip; nothing is uploaded.

segmentationProvider.label: Segmentation provider
segmentationProvider.description: Which configured provider follows the object. Every one is billed per 16 frames of video.
segmentationProvider.nullMeans: Use the workspace's default segmentation provider

maxSegmentationSeconds.label: Longest clip analysed (seconds)
maxSegmentationSeconds.description: A longer source is refused, and the message names its length.

segmentationDetectionThreshold.label: Detection threshold
segmentationDetectionThreshold.description: Lower finds more objects, including wrong ones (0.01 to 1).

maxSegmentationObjects.label: Objects at most per clip
maxSegmentationObjects.description: Each one adds work to the same paid call.

segmentationTimeoutSeconds.label: Provider timeout (seconds)
segmentationTimeoutSeconds.description: How long one call may take before it is abandoned.

detectionSensitivityLimits.description: Detection sensitivity, limits, how much detail the AI editor sees, and other technical settings.

sceneThreshold.label: Shot change sensitivity
sceneThreshold.description: 0 to 1. Lower finds more shot changes.

visualDetail.label: How much visual detail the AI editor sees
visualDetail.description: Less detail leaves room for more shots when the footage is long.

detectLookGroups.label: Group shots with a similar look

keyframesPerShot.label: Frames per shot
keyframesPerShot.description: 1 is a single still; 2-3 show the AI how the shot moves

keyframeMaxWidth.label: Frame width sent to the AI (px)

persistKeyframes.label: Keep the frames
persistKeyframes.description: Saves each described frame next to the analysis

howManyOptions.legend: How many options later steps get

maxObjectDetectFrames.label: Looks per clip at most
maxObjectDetectFrames.description: Each costs one or two AI calls

wordTimestamps.label: Time each word
wordTimestamps.description: Needed for word-by-word captions and precise cuts.

maxAsrChunkBytes.label: Audio chunk size sent for transcription (bytes)

maxDurationSeconds.label: Longest video to edit (minutes)
maxDurationSeconds.description: Leave empty to use the longest video the platform can edit.

maxInputBytes.label: Largest video to edit (GB)
maxInputBytes.description: Leave empty to use the largest video the platform can edit.

howMuchThe.legend: How much the AI editor reads

checksBeforeThe.legend: Checks before the next step runs

expect_atLeastThis.label: At least this many transcript lines

expect_atMostThis.label: At most this share of silence

decisionModelFor.legend: Decision model (for teams collecting calibration data)

derushPrePass.label: Rate each shot before editing
derushPrePass.description: Gives the editor a keep-or-drop hint for every shot. It never removes anything.

derushAcceptAt.label: Confident at or above
derushAcceptAt.description: 0 to 1. 0.85 is a starting point, not a tuned value.

derushMinMargin.label: Minimum margin
derushMinMargin.description: How far from 50/50 an answer must be. 0.25 is a starting point.

screenInstructionLikeSpans.label: Flag text in the footage that looks like instructions to the AI
screenInstructionLikeSpans.description: Such text is pointed out to the editor (never removed). For safety reviews.

videoAnalyze.intro: Watches your footage to find the shots, the pauses and what is said, so the next steps can pick the best moments.

describeShots.intro: An AI looks at a frame from each shot and describes it, which helps the editor understand what is on screen. Costs one AI call per described shot.

trackObjects.intro: One row per object. The free tracker follows flat, rigid things well. Segmentation follows things that bend, turn or get hidden behind something, and is paid.
trackObjects.empty: No objects yet. Add one to blur it, highlight it or show content on it in the final video.
trackObjects.marked: Plus {count, plural, one {# area} other {# areas}} marked by hand or by the assistant.

transcriptionMode.Optional: If possible (recommended): skip it when no speech service is set up
transcriptionMode.Required: Always: stop the run if it cannot transcribe

visionMode.Optional: If possible: skip it when no image AI is set up
visionMode.Required: Always: stop the run if it cannot describe shots

captionSelectionMode.PerDuplicateGroup: One per set of similar takes (fewest calls)

videoAnalyze.prepareHint: Turn on only what a later step uses. Each one makes this step a little slower.

segmentation.title: Following with segmentation
segmentation.egress: Each clip in this step is uploaded to the segmentation provider so it can follow the object. The provider is asked not to keep a copy, and nothing else about the clip leaves this server.
segmentation.blocked: Segmentation is on for at least one object and this is off, so this step cannot run yet. Tick the box to allow the upload, or set that object back to the free tracker.
segmentation.cost: Segmentation is billed per 16 frames of video, rounded up, on top of the usual step cost. A cache hit makes no provider call and bills nothing.

videoAnalyze.limitsHint: On very long footage the least important items are left out to stay within these sizes.
videoAnalyze.checksHint: Stop the run early if the footage does not look right. Leave blank to skip a check.

decision.hint: Both options send text to your Decision service. Leave them off unless an admin has set one up.
decision.cost: One decision call per batch of shots and transcript lines.
decision.egress: The on-screen text and transcript of your video are sent to the Decision service for checking. Use a self-hosted one if that text is confidential.

videoAnalyze.technical: Technical: what this step hands to the next one

pickAnObject.placeholder: Pick an object, or type one

keepWholeSources.label: Keep every source whole (no edit)
keepWholeSources.description: Use every clip in full, without an editor choosing parts, for example to only blur objects or add a screen insert.

keepOrder.label: Order of the clips
keepOrder.description: Whether the editor may move a moment from late in a clip to the start, for example to open on the strongest shot

analysisStepOrder.label: Footage
analysisStepOrder.description: The 'Watch footage' step whose clips this video is made from

analysisStepOrder_footageStepNumber.label: Footage step number
analysisStepOrder_footageStepNumber.description: The number of the 'Watch footage' step whose clips this video is made from

outputFormat.label: Shape
outputFormat.description: Where the video will be posted

outputFit.label: When a clip has a different shape

loudnessTarget.label: Loudness
loudnessTarget.description: Makes the finished video as loud as other videos where it will be posted. The balance between voice and music stays the same.

targetDurationSec.label: Target length (seconds)
targetDurationSec.description: Roughly how long the video should be. Leave at 0 to keep whatever length the edit needs.

registerProjectFile.label: Save to project files
registerProjectFile.description: Lists the finished video in Files so you can download or re-edit it

enableGraphics.label: Add titles and graphics
enableGraphics.description: Adds the titles, name tags and callouts a titles & graphics step planned.

enableInserts.label: Show content on a green screen
enableInserts.description: Places one of your videos or images onto a green phone or monitor screen in the footage, following it as it moves. Needs 'Find green screens' on in the Watch footage step.

insertContentProjectFileId.label: Insert content (your file)
insertContentProjectFileId.description: Shown on every green screen found. Pick it here, not as a clip in the Watch footage step: those are clips to cut, this is what appears on the screen.
insertContentProjectFileId.none: None: use the titles & graphics plan
insertContentProjectFileId.empty: No videos or images uploaded to this project

onlyOnScreens.label: Only on screens in clip number
onlyOnScreens.description: The clip's place in the Watch footage step (1 = first). Empty = any clip.

onlyOnScreen.label: Only on screen
onlyOnScreen.description: A screen id from the Watch footage step's result, such as r2. Empty = any screen.

insertContentDips.label: When your video fades to black
insertContentDips.description: Screen recordings often dip to black between screens, which makes the phone look switched off

insertFit.label: Content fit
insertFit.description: How content of a different shape is fitted to the plate

insertSurface.label: Surface
insertSurface.description: Curved screens get a mesh warp when measured curved

enableInsertMatte.label: Clip to the screen's real shape
enableInsertMatte.description: Keeps rounded corners, the camera notch and fingers crossing the screen in front of the content

mixInsertAudio.label: Mix the sound from the inserted clip
mixInsertAudio.description: Your file's own sound plays while its picture is on the screen — the clicks and the notification pings of a screen recording, for example. A file with no sound, such as a still image, simply stays silent.

insertAudioGainDb.label: Insert sound volume (dB)
insertAudioGainDb.description: 0 keeps your file's own loudness. A negative number turns it down, a positive one turns it up.

minInsertConfidence.label: Minimum tracking confidence
minInsertConfidence.description: 0 to 1. Below this a screen is skipped rather than covered badly

strength.label: Strength
strength.description: 0 to 2. Bigger is stronger; the default is 1.

softEdgePx.label: Soft edge (px)
softEdgePx.description: 0 keeps a crisp edge; up to 64 softens it.

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.description: 1 applies the effect fully, 0 leaves the picture untouched.

everythingExceptThis.label: Everything except this object
everythingExceptThis.description: Applies the effect to the whole picture except the object.

enableColorGrade.label: Apply a colour look
enableColorGrade.description: Applies the colour look a colour step or colour team chose to the whole video.

enableMusic.label: Add background music
enableMusic.description: Plays one of your uploaded tracks under the video, quieter while people talk.

muteSourceAudio.label: Mute the clips' own sound
muteSourceAudio.description: Only the music, narration and sound effects are heard. Useful for generated clips that come with their own audio.

musicTrackProjectFileId.label: Music track
musicTrackProjectFileId.hint: Pick a track yourself, or leave it blank and let a music step choose one of your tracks.
musicTrackProjectFileId.empty: No audio files uploaded to this project

musicDucking.label: While people talk
musicDucking.description: How the music behaves under speech

musicFitPolicy.label: If the track is shorter than the video

beatSync.label: Cut to the beat
beatSync.description: Moves every cut onto the music's beat or bar, and cuts on the drop

enableSfx.label: Add sound effects
enableSfx.description: Adds the whooshes, clicks and hits a sound-effects step chose from your uploaded clips.

maxSfxCues.label: At most this many sound effects

enableVoiceover.label: Mix narration from a Voiceover step
enableVoiceover.description: Places the lines an earlier Voiceover step synthesized on the output timeline and mixes them over the program. Requires Re-encode mode.

voiceoverStep.label: Voiceover step
voiceoverStep.description: The earlier Voiceover step whose lines to mix.

voiceoverMode.label: Source dialogue under narration
voiceoverMode.description: What happens to the original dialogue while a line plays. Replacing it is the basis for dubs and pickups.

enableCaptions.label: Burn captions
enableCaptions.description: Burns the narration into the picture from the words the voice actually spoke and their measured timings. Karaoke and Punch need word timings (a Transcription provider); Subtitle works without them.

enablePickups.label: Splice pickups
enablePickups.description: Replaces the dialogue of the transcript segments a pickup-sourced Voiceover step re-recorded, picture untouched. Requires Re-encode mode.

pickupVoiceoverStep.label: Pickup Voiceover step
pickupVoiceoverStep.description: The Voiceover step (source kind PickupPlan) whose lines are the pickups.

enableGeneratedClips.label: Add generated clips
enableGeneratedClips.description: Places the clips a 'New clips' step generated into the video.

maxGeneratedClips.label: Max generated clips
maxGeneratedClips.description: Any further clips are left out

takeSelection.label: Use a dailies take selection
takeSelection.description: When the generation step made several takes per shot, place only the take a Dailies Room step chose (its first delivered take otherwise). Off places every delivered take as before.

transitionPolicy.label: Transitions between clips
transitionPolicy.description: Off gives plain cuts. Auto picks a soft transition where it suits the footage. Expressive allows more noticeable ones.

encodingCutTiming.description: Encoding, cut timing, transition timing, checks, reframing and inserts by reference. The defaults suit almost every video.

allowKeyframeSnapping.label: Allow keyframe snapping
allowKeyframeSnapping.description: Required for stream copy. In a single continuous cut, the cut points drift to the nearest keyframe.

videoCodec.label: Video codec
videoCodec.description: Output is always 4:2:0 standard-range MP4, so phones and messengers can play it

crf.label: Quality (CRF)
crf.description: Lower is better quality and bigger files. 20 is a good default.

analysisStepResultId.label: Reuse footage analysis from an earlier run (result ID)
analysisStepResultId.placeholder: Leave blank to use this run's analysis

audioSeamRampMs.label: Audio seam ramp (ms)
audioSeamRampMs.description: Half-width of the audio declick ramp an audio-only seam treatment applies around the cut

softCutMs.label: Soft cut (ms)
softCutMs.description: Duration of a soft-cut (short crossfade) treatment

dipCutMs.label: Dip cut (ms)
dipCutMs.description: Duration of a dip-cut (brief dip without a full dip-to-black) treatment

sectionBreakGapMs.label: Section break gap (ms)
sectionBreakGapMs.description: Silence gap that qualifies as a section break rather than a plain cut

maxTransitionMs.label: Max transition (ms)
maxTransitionMs.description: Hard ceiling on any single transition's duration

maxTransitionRatioPct.label: Max transition ratio (%)
maxTransitionRatioPct.description: Caps what percent of all cuts may carry a crossfade-style treatment; excess cuts downgrade to audio-only

maxTransitionSegments.label: Max transition segments
maxTransitionSegments.description: Caps how many cuts in the whole edit may receive a non-hard-cut treatment

expect.label: Min output seconds
expect.description: Refuses an edit that discards nearly everything

insertsOff.title: Screen inserts are switched off
insertsOff.body: Your inserted clip's own sound can only be heard when screen inserts are on. Switch on "Show content on a green screen" above, or switch this sound back off.

copyAudio.title: This sound cannot be mixed in
copyAudio.body: The program's audio is set to be copied as it is, which leaves no room to add anything to it. Choose another audio codec under Advanced below, or switch this sound back off.

keepOrderMode.SourceOrder: In the order it was filmed (default)

outputFitMode.Subject: Fill the frame, keep the subject in shot

regionEffect.Highlight: Highlight it and dim the rest
regionEffect.ColorPop: Colour pop: keep colour on it only

transitionPolicyMode.Auto: Auto: pick a treatment per cut
transitionPolicyMode.Editor: Editor: the editor picks each transition and its speed

videoCompile.intro: Puts the final video together from the clips the editor chose. Extras like music, narration and titles are off until you switch them on below.
videoCompile.subjectFitNote: Each clip is cropped around a tracked screen, or around the subject found by Find the subject of each shot in the analysis step. Clips with neither are cropped in the middle.

insertContents.hint: Different screens can show different files: for example a phone recording on the phone and a desktop recording on the laptop. A screen that no extra content is meant for shows the file above.
insertContents.nothingShown: Pick a file above, or set up a titles & graphics plan above. With neither, nothing is shown on the screen.

effects.intro: One row per object, picked from what the Watch footage step follows. A tracked object is hidden by the free tracker. A segmentation object is handled by the paid one, which can also highlight, spotlight, colour-pop or outline it. The rest of the picture is untouched.
effects.empty: No effects yet. Add an object to blur it or to make it stand out.
effects.invalid: EFFECT_INVALID: name the object this effect applies to, or the step is refused.
effects.limit: {max} effects is the limit: a further one is refused with EFFECT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED rather than dropped.
effects.limitExceeded: EFFECT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: this config lists {count} effects and the limit is {max}. Remove some, or the step is refused.
effects.requiresReencode: EFFECT_REQUIRES_REENCODE: an effect changes pixels, so the mode must be Reencode.
effects.trackedShared: Style, padding and hold are set once for every object you hide, because the free tracker hides them all the same way.
effects.order: Effects are applied to the finished picture: after screen inserts and before the program fade.

musicDuckingMode.SpeechEnvelope: Dip under speech, louder in between

musicFitMode.LoopToFit: Loop to fit the whole edit

fades.title: Fade in at the start and out at the end

encodingMode.StreamCopy: Stream copy: one continuous cut is a lossless copy; a cut with more than one part is re-encoded

transitionTiming.title: Transition timing
transitionTiming.hint: Only used when transitions are not Off.

videoCompile.checksHint: Stop the run early if the edit does not look right. Leave blank to skip a check.

rateControl.label: How to set the file size
rateControl.description: “Look first, with a size limit” and “Aim for a size” need a video bitrate. “Steady look” is the plain quality encode.

options.Capped: Look first, with a size limit

prompts.audioGenerate: What should I ask for, how long should it be, and what should I cap the spend at?
prompts.imageGenerate: What should I describe, which picture should I edit, and what should I cap the spend at?
prompts.conditional: How should I write the condition and choose the true/false branches? Should I use Expression or Decision mode?
prompts.designSystem: What should this brand and product profile step read or require?
prompts.extractFrame: Which video and which frame should this step grab, and what should I do with the image?
prompts.pinInsert: What should this step put on which tracked screen?
prompts.reviewLoop: What minimum score and iteration cap should I use, and is the decision early stop worth enabling?
prompts.room: Which analysis view should it use, and how many rounds and turns make sense? Should I turn on decision scheduling?
prompts.agent: Which agent fits here, and does it need an input mapping or a cache override?
prompts.forEach: What loop source expression should I use and how many iterations?
prompts.parallel: Which agents should run in parallel here?
prompts.extract: Which operation and inputs should this Extract step use?
prompts.thumbnailGenerate: Which frame should this thumbnail use, and what output size and text should it have?
prompts.timelineRender: Which timeline and delivery preset should this render use?
prompts.videoAnalyze: Which clips, transcription and shot-description options fit my footage, and what will they cost?
prompts.videoAnalyzeSpeech: Explain the transcription settings: what they do, what they cost, and a good starting setup.
prompts.videoAnalyzeShots: Explain the shot description settings: what they do, what they cost, and a good starting setup.
prompts.videoAnalyzeTrack: Explain the "Track objects" section: how objects are found and followed, the difference between the free tracker and segmentation, what segmentation costs, and how to blur them afterwards.
prompts.videoCompile: Which extras (titles, music, colour, sound effects, generated clips) should I switch on, and what do they need from earlier steps?
prompts.compileMotion: Explain the "Motion graphics" section: what each setting does, what it costs, and a good starting setup.
prompts.compileInserts: Explain the "Screen inserts" section: what each setting does, what it costs, whether the inserted clip's own sound is mixed in, and a good starting setup.
prompts.compileEffects: Explain "Effects on objects": the difference between an object the free tracker follows and one followed with segmentation, which effects each one allows, what segmentation costs, and a good starting setup.
prompts.compileColour: Explain the "Colour grade" section: what each setting does, what it costs, and a good starting setup.
prompts.compileMusic: Explain the "Background music" section: what each setting does, what it costs, and a good starting setup.
prompts.compileSfx: Explain the "Sound effects" section: what each setting does, what it costs, and a good starting setup.
prompts.compileNarration: Explain the "Narration & captions" section: how the voiceover lines are mixed, what the dialogue modes do, how captions are burned, and a good starting setup.
prompts.compileGenerated: Explain the "Generated clips" section: what each setting does, what it costs, and a good starting setup.
prompts.compileTransitions: Explain the "Transitions & program fades" section: what each setting does, what it costs, and a good starting setup.
prompts.videoGenerate: Should I type one prompt or use a Shot Director plan? What budget and number of takes are sensible?
prompts.voiceover: Which source and voice should I use, and what will it cost?
prompts.videoEnhance: Which video and which improvement should this step apply, and is it free or does it use credits?
prompts.audioCleanup: Which recording should this step clean, what should it fix, and is it worth using credits for it?

sourceKind.PreviousStepOutput: The output of the previous step
sourceKind.StepOutput: The output of a specific step
sourceKind.StepResult: The output of an earlier run (step result ID)

videoEnhance.intro: Improves a video and saves the result to your project files. Making it bigger and smoother can run free on this server or on an outside AI service that uses credits; extending the picture always runs on the outside AI service; cleaning up noise and adding motion blur always run free on this server.

source.nothingBefore: Nothing comes before this step: pick an uploaded file instead.

stepResult.label: Step result ID
stepResult.description: The ID of a step result from an earlier run of this project (shown on the run page)

op.label: Improvement
op.hostedCapableHint: This can run free on this server or on an outside service that uses credits.
op.extendHostedHint: This always runs on the outside service and uses credits.
op.localOnlyHint: This always runs free on this server.

engine.label: Where it runs
engine.freeHint: Runs on this server and costs nothing.
engine.creditsHint: Uses credits, and the video is sent to an outside service.

keepGrain.label: Keep some film grain
keepGrain.description: Cleans the noise but leaves a little texture so it does not look plastic

motionBlur.label: Shutter angle (degrees)
motionBlur.description: Leave blank for the natural look. A bigger angle gives more blur.

mode.label: How to choose the new frame

side.description: Percent of that side, from 1 to 50. Every side you pick grows by this same amount.

prompt.label: What should the new edges show? (optional)
prompt.description: Plain words, up to {max} characters. Leave blank to continue the scene naturally.

maxSeconds.label: Longest video (seconds)
maxSeconds.description: Stops the step on a video longer than this. It can only lower the limit your workspace already has.

save.label: Save to Files
save.description: List the enhanced result in the project files
